subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: Should OpenClaw define a shared degraded/reloading contract for Gateway session RPCs and Control UI during macOS launchd plugin/config reloads, or should this remain operational guidance plus narrower WebChat notice fixes?
rationale: The remaining gap crosses Gateway readiness semantics, session RPC errors, Control UI UX, restart recovery, and macOS managed-service behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the product contract or scope boundary.

options.title: Define shared degraded-state contract
options.body: Add a single reload/readiness state that gates or annotates `sessions.resolve` and Control UI during partial reloads, then prove it with a macOS launchd replay.

options.title: Land only the WebChat notice subset
options.body: Use the related PR to improve blank WebChat recovery notices while leaving this broader partial-reload readiness issue open or split.

options.title: Treat as operational guidance
options.body: Document that live plugin/config maintenance may require `readyz`, status, restart, or doctor recovery and close the broader behavior as out of scope.

recommendation.title: Define shared degraded-state contract
recommendation.body: Add a single reload/readiness state that gates or annotates `sessions.resolve` and Control UI during partial reloads, then prove it with a macOS launchd replay.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily a Gateway/Control UI product contract choice, and this owner has the strongest visible history across the relevant gateway startup, hot-reload, and method-metadata surfaces.
